hook: Did you know Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion into Tigray?

sections.voiceover: Did you know Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion into Tigray?
b_roll: Satellite map showing the border between Ethiopia and Eritrea.

sections.voiceover: Eritrean soldiers crossed into northern Ethiopia towards Adigrat. National army troops clashed with regional forces in Adigrat. Where did the border standoff lead?
b_roll: Map zooming into Adigrat near the Eritrean border.
Footage of military vehicles entering the town.

sections.voiceover: Eritrea urged the United Nations to take deterrent measures, but characterized the confrontation as a declaration of war.
b_roll: Exterior shot of the United Nations headquarters.

sections.voiceover: Ethiopia sent 1 formal letter to the United Nations Security Council. Ethiopian military vehicles entered Adigrat near the Eritrean border. Ethiopia stated it was acting in self-defense.
b_roll: Document view of the letter sent to the Security Council.
Residents celebrating in the streets of Adigrat.

sections.voiceover: Eritrea urged the United Nations to take deterrent measures against Ethiopia.
b_roll: Wide shot of the Tigray regional border landscape.
